**Iron Making {V}** · Designed & developed by Niteen Kumar · © Niteen Kumar, all rights reserved

**Free to install and use.** Copying, renaming or republishing the app is not allowed (see `LICENSE.txt`).

**Android phone:** download `IronMaking-{V}-…-PHONE-INSTALL.apk` and install it. It is signed with the Iron Making release key, so it updates BF Model / Iron Making 5.2 and later and your saved data stays. Or get it from Google Play.
**Windows 10 / 11:** download `IronMaking-{V}-Windows-Setup.exe` and run it. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**. You can also download `IronMaking-{V}-Windows-x64.zip`, unzip it and open `Iron Making.exe`.
**Mac (Apple Silicon M1–M4):** download `IronMaking-{V}-Mac-AppleSilicon.zip`, unzip it, drag the app to Applications, then right-click it and choose Open the first time.
**Mac (Intel):** download `IronMaking-{V}-Mac-Intel.zip`, then follow the same steps.
**iPhone / iPad / Mac App Store:** coming soon.
**Office PC (no install):** download `IronMaking-{V}-Browser-NoInstall.zip`, unzip it and open `Open Iron Making.html`.

**Is my download genuine?** Every file here was built and published by this repository's GitHub workflow:
- Compare the file's SHA-256 with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. On Windows, run `certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256`; on Mac, run `shasum -a 256 <file>`.
- Or check GitHub's signed attestation: `gh attestation verify <file> -R varunnifft/iron-making-through-sinter-pellet-cokeoven-`.
- Android APK certificate SHA-256: `ed:4e:ea:b2:b3:19:27:d7:e9:c0:17:b9:f0:76:8b:bc:82:5b:f8:cf:91:24:21:8b:54:ef:3d:1f:63:d9:d1:cd`

Download Iron Making only from this page, its website, Google Play or the App Store.

**Inside:** BF Model (burden, 3D distribution, furnace 3D view, cohesive & melting zone, hearth liquid, cost optimiser, critical situation plan, taphole check with 3D, tuyere watch, water cooling requirement) · BF blow-in / blow-down planner · Iron complex project & repair · Sinter and coke quality prediction with critical decisions and 3D · Carbon footprint (CBAM) · Learning module.

An account is needed. Logins, uploaded files, saved inputs and suggestions are recorded in the app owner's Google Drive. Values are typical published ranges, so check them against your plant SOP.
